competitor.label: mcp-server-fetch (no open contact-validation server exists; this is what agents use today)

tasks.prompt: What is the E.164 form of the UK phone number 020 7946 0958? Give it only.
Is the phone number +971 50 123 4567 a mobile or a fixed-line number? Answer mobile or fixed-line.
Is the US phone number (202) 555-0143 in the range reserved for fictional use? Answer yes or no.
Does the domain example.com accept email (can mail be delivered to someone@example.com)? Answer yes or no.
Does the domain yahooo.com (three o's) accept email? Answer yes or no.
Is mailinator.com a disposable (throwaway) email provider? Answer yes or no.
A user typed the email address jane@gmial.com. What address did they most likely mean? Give the address only.
Is 1234 a valid US ZIP code? Answer yes or no.
Is the state (Bundesland) a required field of a postal address in Germany? Answer yes or no.

Write the UK address 10 Downing Street, London, SW1A 2AA as Royal Mail formats it for international mail, and tell me: is the postcode on the same line as the town, or on its own line? Answer 'same line' or 'own line'.
